chunks: And in another report, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, he said:
"When the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم bid farewell to a traveler, he would take his hand and then say:"

"May Allah grant you good companionship, complete assistance for you, ease the difficult terrain for you, bring near for you what is far, suffice you regarding what concerns you, preserve for you your religion, your trust, and the final outcomes of your deeds, and direct you to every good. Upon you is the taqwa of Allah. Entrust yourself to Allah. Travel upon the blessing of Allah, Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.أَمَانَتَكَ: your trust and what has been entrusted to you
key_terms.الْحُزُونَةَ: hardship or rough difficulty in the path
key_terms.مُسَافِرًا: a traveler who is departing on a journey

ai.seo_question: What du'a did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say when bidding farewell to a traveler?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would recite when bidding farewell to a traveler. It emphasizes care for the traveler’s safety, religion, trustworthiness, and successful completion of affairs, while grounding the journey in taqwa and reliance upon Allah.
